lessons.title: Goroutines, Channels & CSP Paradigm
overview: Deep dive into Go's M:N scheduler, channel buffering, and communicating sequential processes.
Prevent goroutine leaks and deadlocks using select statements with context deadlines.

takeaways.title: Goroutine Lifecycle
takeaways.desc: Always bind goroutine lifecycles to parent context cancellation.

takeaways.title: Buffered Channels
takeaways.desc: Size channel buffers with strict backpressure to avoid unbounded heap growth.
